g.text: Build and push the OS-dependencies images for one platform, on the mirrored hardened base images.
Python major/minor version used in Airflow image for images (if not specified - all
Installation type of the OS-dependencies images (if not specified - all of them).
JSON object with the digest of each mirrored base image tag to build on - the
'os-deps-base-image-digests' output of mirror-base-images. Tags missing from it are
Platform to build the images for - each one is built natively, on a runner of its own.
Print verbose information about performed steps.
If dry-run is set, commands are only printed, not executed.
